repos.name: Production-Management-System-Angular-Enterprise-Application
repos.description: A comprehensive production management system built with Angular 18 and TypeScript. Features real-time dashboard, daily production tracking, raw materials inventory management, employee shift scheduling, product catalog administration, and detailed reporting capabilities. Implements modular architecture with lazy loading, server-side rendering (SSR)

repos.name: Machine-Learning-Analysis-of-Player-Performance-in-CS-GO
repos.description: Machine Learning Project Applied to CSGO. Exploratory analysis, supervised modeling (regression and classification), player segmentation (KMeans), detection of outlier behaviors, and strategic performance analysis in competitive Counter-Strike: Global Offensive matches.

repos.name: Laravel-Commerce
repos.description: A full-featured e-commerce platform built with Laravel, including customer storefront and comprehensive admin panel.

repos.name: Concrete-Strength-Prediction-with-Machine-Learning
repos.description: The work focuses on the development of a predictive model to estimate the strength of concrete using machine learning techniques and neural networks. The objective is to create an accurate model that can predict the strength of concrete based on various characteristics such as concrete age, cement content, amount of water and other components.
